srList.sentence: Cell culture , siRNA transfection and protein analysis Human lung adenocarcinoma cell line A549 , neuroblastoma cell line SK-N-BE(2 ) and IMR90 fetal lung fibroblasts were purchased from American Type Culture Collection ( ATCC , Rockville , MD , USA ) and cultured in RPMI medium supplemented with 10 % fetal bovine serum ( Invitrogen , Carlsbad , CA , USA ) and 1 % antibiotic/antimycotic ( Sigma , St Louis , MO , USA) .
